capacity_gross_kwh.notes: GM spec: 65 kWh LFP pack (prismatic cells); GM lists it as rated energy, not usable. Gross by default.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: No page states a usable figure. GM publishes 65 kWh as the pack size and recommends charging this LFP pack to 100 % (GM Authority, search excerpt), so 65 kWh is used for usable too. WEAK basis (search excerpt, no maker statement of usable). An owner OBD scan read 69.9 kWh (wind-works.org, flagged unreliable by its author).

chemistry.notes: InsideEVs: "new 65-kilowatt-hour lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) battery"; GM specs say LFP in prismatic can cells, cell-to-pack.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs: the LFP pack has "a nominal voltage that's a lot closer to 400" (than the ~290 V Ultium modules); AutoGuide calls it a 400 V architecture (search excerpt). No GM figure.

preconditioning.notes: GM release relayed by Automotive World: "If DC fast charging is available along your route, automatic battery preconditioning gives your battery a warm-up" via Google Maps. No manual control found in the release.

dc_max_kw.notes: GM: peak 150 kW or more; InsideEVs test reached 151 kW (156 kW at 18 %).

ac_max_kw.notes: GM spec relayed by EVWire and The EV Report: AC up to 11.5 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: GM: about 26 minutes for 10-80 % on public DC fast charging (Automotive World, InsideEVs); a KBB piece says 25.
